displayDetailReview.reason: Adopt the exact common interior modern Red Sea coast and all 45 modern SDN non-mainland components, preserving original political borders, dates, source notes, and historical uncertainty.

parameters.operation: intersection-clipped coast subarc plus complete donor component set

topology.scope: The selected coast operation replays exactly, all 45 donor components are retained, and every original political edge plus all old/current scoped peer overlaps and shared lines remain unchanged. Existing old-to-current neighbor mismatch is preserved, not repaired. Dates are retained, not newly inferred.

limitations: The existing historical version is exactly a modern NE SDN+SDS successor union, not an independently reconstructed historical boundary.
An approved-modern source update does not prove historical control or title across 1956-01-01..2011-07-08.
Halaib/Bir Tawil, al-Fashaga, Wadi Halfa and Ilemi limitations remain explicit. Matching inclusion conventions does not establish identical historical boundary routes.
No whole-world or runtime/compiled historical validation was performed. Source application requires a fresh parent review and preimage check.
modernRedSeaCoastAndAllComponentsReuse.scope: Replace source mainland vertices 222..421 using two source/donor intersections and exact donor vertices 940..1646; replace the single old offshore component with all 45 approved SDN components. All political edges and both coastline junctions remain exact. This is not the full SDN+SDS union.

sourceAttributionsAppend.role: Partial interior coast and all approved SDN Red Sea components; inherited political boundaries unchanged.
